understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem (+) by navigating horizontally and using gravity-driven falls through successive sections without landing on hazards.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT shift the player horizontally, after which the player automatically falls in the current gravity direction until landing, hitting a hazard, or reaching the goal. CLICK removes a clickable breakable block at the specified position without moving the player, while UNDO reverts the previous action. Spikes cause immediate failure, and safe tiles provide landing support; passage columns indicate useful drops to new sections.
